content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen reads well with photo, headline and one action, but the page below is a long single column of text lists with large empty bands before the second photo and around \"Kje delam\".","desktopNote":"Sections leave huge dead bands (hero bottom, below the services table, around \"Zakaj me pokličejo\" and \"Kje delam\"), and the second photo is cropped so the piano action loses its subject.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Tighten section padding on desktop: cut the empty bands below the hero, services table, Zakaj me pokličejo and Kje delam to a consistent rhythm.","Fill the right half of the desktop list sections (services, why me) with a photo or pull the list to full width so half the screen isn't blank.","Give \"Kje delam\" real weight: a small map or area list instead of a lone line floating in white space, and move the brand name in the footer down a size so it doesn't read as a second hero."],"blockers":[]}
